name: Gan'rul's Summons
summary: Ophek brings Gan'rul's Summons to young Horde warlocks in Razor Hill. Gan'rul Bloodeye calls them to the Cleft of Shadow to advance their training. There, they take the first step toward summoning a voidwalker.

sections.title: A Summons to the Shadows
sections.body: In Durotar, novice warlocks do not go unnoticed for long. When a practitioner shows enough mastery over an initial imp, word reaches the deep caverns beneath Orgrimmar. Ophek carries messages for the senior dark casters from his post in Durotar. He finds warlocks with an urgent demand to leave their work and report to the Cleft of Shadow.

sections.title: The Senior Warlock
sections.body: Gan'rul Bloodeye oversees the training of young orc warlocks within the Horde. From the hidden caverns beneath Orgrimmar, he hones their lethal fel power while keeping these dangerous arts from the Warchief's disapproving gaze. A call to his circle means simple fire spells and imps are no longer enough. The apprentice is ready to bind a creature from the Twisting Nether.

faq.answer: Ophek is an associate of the warlocks stationed in Durotar. He watches for rising practitioners and carries orders from senior mentors such as Gan'rul Bloodeye.
Gan'rul Bloodeye is in the Cleft of Shadow, a dark cavern system beneath Orgrimmar's rocky plateaus.

faq.q: Why does Gan'rul Bloodeye want to see me?
faq.answer: Gan'rul considers you ready to advance your warlock studies and begin the dangerous rites to summon and bind a voidwalker.

faq.q: What happens after reporting to Gan'rul?
faq.answer: Reporting to Gan'rul begins Creature of the Void. You are sent to find the components and knowledge needed to draw a void entity into Azeroth.

faq.q: Why do the warlocks stay in the Cleft of Shadow?
faq.answer: Warlocks practice volatile fel magic, which Thrall and the traditional shamanic Horde regard with deep suspicion. The Cleft of Shadow lets them perform rituals out of public view.

faq.q: Can any class take this quest?
faq.answer: No. Only Horde warlocks who have reached the tenth circle of their training can receive the summons.

angles.text: As a warlock, this summons marks your path beyond basic imp conjuration. It opens the way to command a voidwalker's sturdy protection.
As a member of the Horde, you know warlocks hold an uneasy place in Thrall's new Horde. Their pragmatic power is tolerated, while they remain secluded beneath Orgrimmar.
